set_blocked_apps.name: Set blocked apps
set_blocked_apps.description: Set the blocked apps for a profile.

blocked_apps.name: Blocked apps
blocked_apps.description: (Required) List of apps to block. Passing an empty list will unblock all supported apps.

target_profile.name: Target profile(s)
target_profile.description: (Optional) Name(s) or ID(s) of profile(s) to set. Defaults to all profiles if not specified.

target_network.name: Target network(s)
target_network.description: (Optional) Name(s) or ID(s) of network(s) in which desired profile(s) are located. Defaults to all networks if not specified.

create_reservation.name: Create reservation
create_reservation.description: Create a DHCP reservation on a network.

target_network.name: Target network(s)
target_network.description: (Required) Name(s) or ID(s) of network(s) to create the reservation on.

public_static_ip.name: Public static IP
public_static_ip.description: (Optional) Whether this reservation also has a public static IP.

delete_reservation.name: Delete reservation
delete_reservation.description: Delete a DHCP reservation from a network.

target_network.name: Target network(s)
target_network.description: (Required) Name(s) or ID(s) of network(s) to delete the reservation from.

reservation.name: Reservation
reservation.description: (Required) The reservation's own ID, as reported by the eero API.

delete_forwards.name: Delete forwards
delete_forwards.description: (Optional) Whether to also delete port forwards referencing this reservation's IP.

create_port_forward.name: Create port forward
create_port_forward.description: Create a port forward on a network.

target_network.name: Target network(s)
target_network.description: (Required) Name(s) or ID(s) of network(s) to create the forward on.

ip.name: IP address
ip.description: (Required) The internal IP address to forward to.

client_port.name: Client port
client_port.description: (Required) The internal port to forward to.

gateway_port.name: Gateway port
gateway_port.description: (Required) The external port to forward from.

protocol.name: Protocol
protocol.description: (Required) The protocol, e.g. tcp or udp.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: (Optional) Whether the forward is active. Defaults to true.

delete_port_forward.name: Delete port forward
delete_port_forward.description: Delete a port forward from a network.

target_network.name: Target network(s)
target_network.description: (Required) Name(s) or ID(s) of network(s) to delete the forward from.

forward.name: Forward
forward.description: (Required) The forward's own ID, as reported by the eero API.

set_custom_dns.name: Set custom DNS
set_custom_dns.description: Set custom DNS servers for a network, or switch it back to automatic. Warning: every DNS write reboots the entire mesh a few minutes later.

target_network.name: Target network(s)
target_network.description: (Required) Name(s) or ID(s) of network(s) to set custom DNS for.

ipv4.name: IPv4 servers
ipv4.description: (Optional) IPv4 DNS server addresses. A family not supplied is left untouched.

ipv6.name: IPv6 servers
ipv6.description: (Optional) IPv6 DNS server addresses. A family not supplied is left untouched.

automatic.name: Automatic
automatic.description: (Optional) Switch both families back to automatic (ISP-provided) DNS, ignoring ipv4/ipv6. Defaults to false.

api_error.message: The eero API rejected the request: {error}

auth_failed.message: The eero session has expired. Sign in again from the integration page.

resource_unavailable.message: This eero resource is no longer reported by the API.

rate_limited.message: Rate limited by the eero API; the next poll is in {seconds} seconds.

timeout.message: Timed out talking to the eero API.

premium_required.title: eero Plus required for {feature}
premium_required.description: Network {network} is not entitled to {feature}: it needs an eero Plus subscription. The entities that depend on it are not created. This notice clears itself once the subscription is active.

feature_unavailable.title: {feature} is not available
feature_unavailable.description: Network {network} does not offer {feature} (the hardware or the account does not support it). The entities that depend on it are not created. This notice clears itself if the feature becomes available.
